notes.title: New DLC - Supporter Pack!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2056260/Adventure_in_My_Head_Supporter_Pack/]A new pack[/url] has been released for those who just want to support the developer and wish him good luck in his work! :)
This pack contains:
- 8 soundtracks
- 25 images
- secret :)

After purchase, it can be found in the game folder.

Thanks for the support!

notes.title: The Adventure in My Head soundtrack is out!
notes.notes:
The soundtrack for the game Adventure in My Head has finally been released on streaming services! Listen wherever you want and as much as you want.

And also, it's my birthday today :)

notes.title: 1000 downloads
notes.notes:
Already 1000 people have downloaded and launched the game "Adventure in My Head", and it's cool! Thank you very much!
We also noticed that some people paid attention to the music. At the moment it is available on YouTube at this [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dySfYJZOO40]link[/url]
But in the future, it may be available on all music platforms.

Thank you for playing and writing reviews!
